frame_image_note: Cung ho quet sang dau video nhu smoky-pedestal, quet het o ~frame 20/129. Frame 20 la luc splash nuoc da day du (hinh vuong mien, chua co mau neon) va chua co vet quet -- dung lam anh ban dau.
effect_prompt: A dynamic crown-shaped water splash erupts and surges around the base of the product, water droplets flying and scattering realistically in the air, with ripples spreading outward across the dark reflective wet surface below. Glowing neon electric light streaks, shaped like crackling lightning bolts, flicker and pulse through the splash and its reflection, cycling smoothly through different vivid colors over time (pink, cyan, and back). The background stays a deep dark studio gradient with a soft horizon glow. The camera remains completely fixed, framing the product centered throughout.
effect_prompt_note: Quan sat 6 khung trai deu video 129 khung/24fps: frame20 splash trang chua mau -> frame30 neon hong/do quanh vien splash+phan chieu -> frame45-60 doi sang neon xanh ngoc/cyan, hien them tia set doc hai ben vuot ra khoi splash -> frame90 splash bung manh hon, giot nuoc bay day khung -> frame120 lang xuong, con sot anh do nhat. Camera KHONG di chuyen (khac smoky-pedestal co turntable xoay) -- khung hinh/kich thuoc san pham giu nguyen suot clip.
